title: XIA Nightly Processor configuration
description: Revalidates queued Jira issues for pending XIA archive requests and bulk-moves eligible ones into the Jira XIA project.

JIRA_BASE_URL.title: Jira base URL:
JIRA_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of your Jira Cloud instance, e.g. https://your-domain.atlassian.net

JIRA_USERNAME.title: Jira username:
JIRA_USERNAME.description: Jira account email/username used for Basic Auth together with the API token.

#jira_api_token.title: Jira API token:
#jira_api_token.description: Jira API token for the account above. Obtain it from Jira Cloud account security settings.

debug.title: Enable Debug Logging:
debug.description: If true, enables verbose debug logging in the job output.
